products.name: Remove Text From Video
products.tagline: Remove burned-in subtitles, captions, timestamps, logos and watermarks from video with AI.
products.description: RTFV is an online tool that removes burned-in subtitles, captions, timestamps, logos, and watermarks from video using AI. Upload a clip, choose how to find the text, and download a version with the original frame intact. There is nothing to install and no timeline to learn.
products.useCases:
Clean subtitles off clips before translating them
Remove timestamps, logos and watermarks from reused footage
products.features:
Auto mode finds the usual bottom caption band on its own
Box select for text anywhere in the frame
Temporal inpainting rebuilds the covered scene

products.longDescription:
RTFV is an online tool that removes burned-in subtitles, captions, timestamps, logos, and watermarks from video using AI. Upload a clip, choose how to find the text, and download a version with the original frame intact. There is nothing to install and no timeline to learn.

The workflow has three steps: upload a video clip, choose how to find the text, then download the processed video. The tool runs online, requires no installation, and keeps the original frame intact.
